model_rule: Capabilities are independent, not an arbitrary security hierarchy or score.

initial_hypotheses.claim: An authorized page may lack extension worker state access while a browser-protocol operator can inspect its runtime program and modify results.
initial_hypotheses.prerequisites: A verified Chromium-family browser supporting temporary extensions and worker debugging.
initial_hypotheses.positive_controls: Normal application result; independent page decrypt hook positive control; worker target identification; before/after program and output.

initial_hypotheses.claim: Real account identity, request binding and operation-specific challenges can stop copied or proxy-relayed requests without concealing all allowed behavior.
initial_hypotheses.prerequisites: Owned authenticated local application with ground-truth richer workloads.

initial_hypotheses.claim: Moving execution into a privileged browser component changes page and extension access but remains removable by a browser owner.
initial_hypotheses.prerequisites: Isolated browser distribution with a verifiable privileged execution path.

initial_hypotheses.claim: Hardware-backed provisioning requires independently verified hardware and attestation; a software model alone cannot establish that property.
initial_hypotheses.prerequisites: Actual capability probe and explicit model/implementation distinction.

success_rule: I report extracted information, held-out replication, accepted unauthorized operations and matched performance separately. A failed capture alone is not copying resistance.
